checkpoint: Vue conditional and receiving slot lifetime fixes, based on 38fb4973
changes: Shared immutable-definition slot analysis retains the existing repeated-slot inventory and adds removable destinations under conditions, matches and iteration. Vue uses those facts for ordinary source lifetime. Permanent single outlets and scoped slots keep native Vue rendering.

Accepting as-list projections opt into one existing PlainFrame only for repeated or removable receiving destinations. ChildNodes places that retained projection once; PlainPlacement is transparent to accepted-instance registration. Receiving projection and child slot frames dispose with their source.
Ordinary conditional outlets preserve native inputs while authored lazy templates instantiate fresh content after reopening. Lazy template markers include these selected destinations.

Public converted tests use actual fresh Vue and renderToString/createSSRApp hydration, including pre-hydration edits, counter state, caller prop changes, injected state context while the root is unplaced, reopening and disposal. SSR bundles load from temporary files for readable failure stacks.
